scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('Backend/Public', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('Frontend/dist', 'Backend/Public', {recursive: true});"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,YJS,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run yjs --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
